title: Probe Generalization Across the Attack-Family Link: Train on One, Test on Another

original_idea.body: # Probe Generalization Across the Attack-Family Link. Train a linear probe on one jailbreak family, evaluate cross-family transfer for all pairs, producing a transfer matrix testing the shared-signature assumption.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests deployability of activation-probe jailbreak defense; clear chain to monitoring reliability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation extraction + linear probe transfer matrix on open model; guided, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped transfer matrix over fixed attack families with clear cross-family AUROC.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Studies a defense's blind spots with public models; weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Linear probes on cached activations from one open model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Probe transfer studied; full attack-family matrix tied to distinct-mechanism finding may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-family probe transfer partially studied; systematic matrix angle plausibly open.
